name: @rutba/ocr
description: Text recognition on this computer: recognize(image, { languages }) answers the text, its lines and its words with their boxes and confidence, worked out on a pool of threads by Tesseract 5 in WebAssembly with six fast models shipped inside, never fetching anything; and the page analysis of our own around it (deskew, binarisation, text size, lines, columns and table cells).
